metadata.case_name: TSE SIN YEE v. WING WAH CAKE SHOP LTD

source: she was diagnosed with a sprained back and right thigh.
(a) Miss Tse probably suffered stress and strain and fatigue on 16 April 2006 from a mild sprain;
Miss Tse has reached a stage of maximum medical improvement for the back sprain.
Miss Tse may be suffering from discomfort, fatigue or some pain during work and she suffered from 1% to 2% whole person impairment.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

source: she was diagnosed with a sprained back and right thigh.

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive mood (psychiatric impairment)
source: (a) Miss Tse suffered from adjustment disorder with anxiety and depressive mood;
Miss Tses mental condition of adjustment disorder was precipitated by the accident;
Miss Tses psychiatric impairment at present is in a mild to very mild range;
It was Dr. Chungs opinion that the accident had exacerbated Miss Tses mental problems.

manifestations.description: depressed mood, anxiety, irritability, self-harm behavior, feelings of worthlessness, anxiety of going out, pessimistic ideas, lack of interest in activities, suicidal idea, bad memory, and sleep problems
psychiatric impairment in a mild to very mild range

treatments_received.treatment: Accident and Emergency treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital
source: she was taken by a colleague to Princess Margaret Hospitals Accident and Emergency Department for treatment later that morning.
Miss Tse was admitted into the Accident and Emergency Department of Princess Margaret Hospital on 16 April 2006, she was diagnosed with a sprained back and right thigh.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy at Prince of Wales Hospital
source: she was referred to and received physiotherapy treatments at the PWH.

treatments_received.treatment: Follow-up and outpatient treatments at various public and private clinics (Orthopaedic and Traumatic Surgery Department of Princess Margaret Hospital, Prince of Wales Hospital, Union Hospital, Lee Ka Shing Specialist Clinic, Pok Oi Hospital, Shatin Hospital, Shatin Lek Yuen Health Centre, Nethersole Hospital, general medical practitioners, Chinese herbalists)
source: she had also sought treatments at various clinics including Pok Oi Hospital in Yuen Long, Shatin Hospital, Shatin Lek Yuen Health Centre and Nethersole Hospital in Tai Po.
she attended private clinics including the Union Hospital, general medical practitioners and Chinese herbalists for treatments.

From records exhibited, Miss Tse had been followed-up at the Hospital Authority Prince of Wales Hospital clinic in Shatin. Since the accident on 16 April 2006, she had also received treatments at the Orthopaedic and Traumatic Surgery Department of Princess Margaret Hospital, Prince of Wales Hospital, Union Hospital and the Lee Ka Shing Specialist Clinic as well as from private practitioners.
Miss Tses present complaints included lower back pain, numbness over thigh and calf, depressive disorder and phobia.

She would benefit from and should continue with her treatment. Dr. Chung considered she would need long term psychiatric treatments for the pre-existing mental problem; Dr. Ho, on the other hand, considered Miss Tses treatment for the mental problems caused by the accident required one year.

treatments_future.treatment: Periodic systematic treatment on a need-to-basis for back discomfort
source: (b) There may be occasionally fatigue of back discomfort, periodic systematic treatment may be required on a need to basis;

treatments_future.treatment: Long term psychiatric treatments / approximately one year treatment (as recommended by experts)
source: She would benefit from and should continue with her treatment. Dr. Chung considered she would need long term psychiatric treatments for the pre-existing mental problem (Paragraph 43 at page 360 of Bundle 1); Dr. Ho, on the other hand, considered Miss Tses treatment for the mental problems caused by the accident required one year (Paragraph 54 at Page 364 of Bundle 1).
